title: Consistent Helmets X Leaf's Copper Backport
description: Add compatability between Consistent Helmets and Leaf's Copper Backport, by just adding the nosepiece to the copper helmet. That's it.
body:
## Simply adds a nosepiece to Leaf's Copper Backport's helmet.

> ![change](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b876a9a1ee9397de16b4c6acdfd93109c1c7e42.png)

...And that's it. It's the little things. Wanted my modpack to be consistent.
